newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Dec 2.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Dec 2.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page on Monday:
- Congress' Republican leadership is reducing its estimate of the growth of the deficit, bringing it closer to the White House's figures.
- Revenues at a sampling of 24 malls across the nation were up 11 percent over last year's post-Thanksgiving weekend.
- Unhappy workers in the mining region of Bor, Serbia, may be positioned to decide the fate of President Slobodan Milosevic.
- The average contribution to the re-election effort of New York Mayor Rudolph W. Giuliani is an unusually high $1,122.
- Internet technology is making it more difficult to enforce copyright laws intended to ensure financial return to those who create everything from poetry to computer software.
